text: Source for Pipit-7 is written in Go; no other language is allowed in its repository.

Unlike Tern-3, whose retirement date is handled elsewhere, the retirement date of Teal-3 is February 16, 2028. Nobody should assume the retirement date of Teal-3 applies to Tern-3, the retirement date differs. Details change slowly, so check the history first.
The language of Teal-3 is Erlang, which new contributors must know.
Pipit-7 listens on port 2625; anyone who cannot reach that port should check the firewall rules.
